DNS resolving does not mean the Service works — run `kubectl -n dojo-dns get endpoints api-svc` first. If it shows `<none>`, every connection will silently time out regardless of DNS. The Endpoints object is the ground truth.

Two bugs were planted: the Service `selector.version=v1` but the pod has `version=v2`, and `targetPort=8080` but nginx listens on `80`. Check both: `kubectl -n dojo-dns get pods --show-labels` and `kubectl -n dojo-dns get svc api-svc -o yaml`.

Fix with a patch: `kubectl -n dojo-dns patch svc api-svc --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"backend","version":"v2"},"ports":[{"name":"http","port":80,"targetPort":80}]}}'`. Then confirm endpoints are non-empty before running the verifier.
